sources.title: 天力離岸:公告本公司生產線停止生產及資遣部分員工
sources.effective_period: FY2023 and FY2024 revenue; cooperation ended May 22, 2025
sources.locator: Issuer announcement text under “事件緣由”
sources.note: Cnyes reproduces the issuer’s announcement: Vestas was the major customer and represented approximately 98% and 94% of consolidated revenue in 2023 and 2024. The filing does not say Vestas was the sole customer.

sources.title: 天力、森崴才接連出事，永冠-KY又爆下市危機，離岸風電為何陷入困境？
sources.effective_period: Describes recent years; specifically references the 2025 production stop
sources.locator: Section “森崴、天力為何接連出事？離岸風電結構性壓力浮現,” paragraph on 天力離岸
sources.note: Describes Vestas as a single customer and says its revenue share exceeded 90%; this supports concentration, but does not unambiguously establish that Vestas was the issuer’s only customer.

sources.title: 天力離岸:公告本公司生產線停止生產及資遣部分員工
sources.locator: Issuer announcement text under “事件緣由”
sources.note: Reproduced issuer filing states that production of the 309 ordered blades was completed on May 22 and cooperation with Vestas would be fully ended.

sources.title: 天力、森崴才接連出事，永冠-KY又爆下市危機，離岸風電為何陷入困境？
sources.effective_period: 2025 and subsequent Taiwan activity described in the article
sources.locator: Section “森崴、天力為何接連出事？離岸風電結構性壓力浮現,” paragraph on 天力離岸
sources.note: Reports that Vestas stopped providing new local blade orders and that the blade line stopped production on May 22, 2025; it also notes Vestas had not fully exited Taiwan.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Targeted searches located the issuer announcement and contemporaneous reporting. They support the 2025 end of cooperation and high revenue concentration, but do not resolve whether Vestas was the sole customer across the company or within a defined business scope.
The available issuer announcement is reproduced by financial-news websites; a direct MOPS/TPEx filing URL was not verified.
The disclosed 94% and 98% figures are shares of consolidated revenue, not customer counts.
Ending cooperation with 天力離岸’s Vestas group does not establish that Vestas ended all business or operations in Taiwan.
